Fields.Name: End Of Clip Event
Fields.Description: The event sent when the selected clip ends. -1 for none.

Fields.Name: Variable Bindings
Fields.Description: The bindings that drive this object's fields from behavior variables or character properties each frame.

Fields.Name: User Data
Fields.Description: A value for the game's own use; Havok doesn't read it.

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: The node's name. Used to find it in the outline and in the action scripts; it doesn't have to be unique.

Fields.Name: Selected Generator Index
Fields.Description: The index of the generator that plays. Usually bound to a variable.

Fields.Name: Index Selector
Fields.Description: Picks the selected index when the selector activates. Overrides Selected Generator Index when set.

Fields.Name: Selected Index Can Change After Activate
Fields.Description: Whether a change to the selected index after activation switches generator. Off: the choice is kept until the selector is activated again.

Fields.Name: Generator Changed Transition Effect
Fields.Description: The transition effect used when the selected generator changes while active. None: switch at once.
